question: Which of the following is an example of capital receipt?

options.text: Disinvestment of Public Sector Banks by the Government

solution:
The correct answer is __**Disinvestment of Public Sector Banks by the Government.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Disinvestment of Public Sector Banks:-**

 
 
• It is an example of capital receipt because it involves selling a government asset (shares in public sector banks) to raise funds for the government.
